Portable stair lifts, patient lifts, and climbing hand trucks — from one partner.

Three product lines

A complete mobility and material-handling story.

Serve patients, caregivers, and your own delivery drivers from a single manufacturer relationship.

Mobile Stairlift™

Battery-powered portable stair lift alternatives for renters, travelers, and families who can't or won't install a permanent stairlift or ramp.

Portable stair climbers

Mobile Patient Lift™

Sling-free patient transfer lifts, sit-to-stand, shower and toilet solutions, and fall-recovery chairs for home and care environments.

Transfers & recovery

Voltstair™ Hand Trucks

Powered climbing hand trucks that carry appliances, lift chairs, hospital beds, and heavy equipment up and down stairs with minimal strain.

For delivery teams

Featured products

Top sellers across the lineup.

A best-in-class pick from each category.

Mobile Stairlift — lightweight

Lite Stair Lift

The lightest portable stair lift, built for travel, multi-location use, and easier caregiver handling.

  • Just 44 lbs; supports up to 250 lbs.
  • Up to 100 flights of stair travel per charge.
  • Motorized auto-braking tracks — no manual lifting.
  • Rear foot brakes, seat belt, and manual free-wheel mode.
View product →
Mobile Patient Lift — bathing

Freedom Aqua Patient Lift

A sling-free electric transfer lift that's shower-safe for everyday transfers and bathing.

  • Sling-free seat closes around the user — no overhead lifting.
  • IPX5 shower-safe for wet environments.
  • 90° split seat slides easily under the user.
  • Powered seat height 19"–29"; up to 300 lbs, ~150 lifts per charge.
View product →
Mobile Patient Lift — fall recovery

Lift Buddy Fall Recovery Chair

A motorized chair that lifts a fallen user from the floor to a secure seated height.

  • Raises the seat from 2.8" to 22.4" for controlled recovery.
  • Eliminates dangerous manual lifting for caregivers.
  • Supportive backrest and armrests keep the user balanced.
  • Up to 440 lbs; lightweight 44.5 lb frame.
View product →

Intorducing the Mobile Stairlift

Genesis

Introducing the Genesis Powered Stair Chair - the perfect solution for familiys needing to transport individuals up or down the stairs. This motorized lift offers a safe and efficient way to transport riders of up to 400lbs. The Genesis Powered Stair Chair is a foldable and portable design, allowing families to quickly store it in the vehicle and ready to use right out of the box. One of the main benefits of this motorized lift is that the tracks hold the person's weight, reducing the risk of injury to the family member.

Freedom Transfer Patient Lift

Freedom Lift without Sling

The Freedom Transfer Patient Lift is a sling-free, seated alternative to a traditional Hoyer or patient lift - a versatile, durable device designed to help caregivers transfer loved ones safely and comfortably in home care settings.

For your delivery team

Climbing hand trucks that deliver the heavy equipment you sell.

Get lift chairs, hospital beds, and heavy equipment up and down stairs and in and out of homes — without a two-person struggle or a hand injury.

Best for heavy lifting

Voltstair Hercules

Made for nearly all delivery needs — bulky, cumbersome items like appliances, safes, and large equipment.

  • Carries up to 500 lbs; low lifting platform minimizes strain.
  • Up to 120 flights per charge; lightweight 56 lbs.
  • Color-coded control panel and dual locking wheels.
  • Detachable security strap keeps the load on the platform.
View product →
Best for stability

Voltstair Titan

Shines on the heaviest, most strenuous loads with rear handles and a professional-grade ratchet system.

  • 440 lb lift capacity; 60 flights per charge.
  • Three speed controls to match your pace.
  • Foldable rear handles for flat-surface maneuvering.
  • Professional-grade ratchet belt and dual locking wheels.
View product →

Voltstair Titan

Powered Handtruck

The Voltstair Titan shines when carrying strenuous loads as the rear handles and professional grade ratchet system are invaluable for the heaviest of tasks. The Voltstair lifts are great for Transporting Lift Chairs, Heavy Duty Beds and heavy loads in patient home or at work.
